players.product: Enhanced geothermal (EGS) 24/7 baseload power from modular GeoBlocks (Cape Station geocluster, Utah) under long-term PPAs with hyperscalers, utilities and industrial buyers, grid-connected and behind-the-meter

quarterly_data.quarter: Fervo Energy press release: Fervo Energy Achieves First Power at Cape Station, a (09-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Fervo's First Power release: the first 33-megawatt GeoBlock of Cape Station Phase I in Beaver County, Utah is synchronized to the grid and exporting electricity, which the company calls the first time a utility-scale enhanced geothermal development has reached this milestone anywhere in the world. Fully contracted offtake at Cape Station sits at approximately 900 MW, and the release calls First Power 'the first megawatts of a multi-gigawatt development, with 900 MW fully contracted and more than 4 GW of capacity'. CEO Tim Latimer: 'we believe it shows that the commercial and technical maturity of EGS is ready to meet the urgent need for reliable, clean power ... We are just getting started.'
quarterly_data.figure: Cape Station fully contracted offtake approximately 900 MW; more than 4 GW of capacity
